description: This file defines the NotebookRepository class, which manages data operations related to notebooks, interfacing with NotebookDao for database actions and NoteRepository to handle associated notes.

classes.name: NotebookRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing notebook data operations, including insertion, deletion, updating, and retrieval of notebooks.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new notebook into the database via NotebookDao.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more notebooks and their associated notes if they are not local only.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates one or more notebooks; optional parameter for synchronization control.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a notebook by its ID wrapped in a Flow.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all notebooks as a Flow list.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a notebook by its name wrapped in a Flow.
